# Tersa

> Tersa (also called Tersa Tech) makes small open-source tools that remove what you never asked for. Every tool previews its changes before applying them, and everything can be undone. The first tool is BraveDebloater.

Tersa is a non-commercial project run by Vince, a private individual in Hungary. The name comes from the Latin tersus: wiped clean. Tersa has no affiliation with Brave Software, Inc., which owns the Brave trademark. Contact: iqad@tersa.tech.

## Tools

- [BraveDebloater README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/osfv/BraveDebloater/main/README.md): Install steps, presets, every feature it can turn off, and how to restore a backup
- [BraveDebloater repository](https://github.com/osfv/BraveDebloater): MIT-licensed PowerShell tool for Windows, macOS and Linux. It turns off Brave extras such as Rewards, Wallet, VPN, Leo, News and telemetry through Brave's own enterprise policies. It runs a dry-run preview by default, writes a backup before applying anything, and refuses to disable Shields, Safe Browsing or updates.
